dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped light-gray rings against a dark background, primarily concentrated on the anterior flank; perimeters show a sharp gradient transition from light borders to darker internal cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid light-gray pixel clusters and irregular amorphous blotches without internal gradients, scattered along the dorsal ridge and extending toward the posterior region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest anterior annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle; a series of smaller high-intensity clusters forms a secondary linear alignment parallel to the lateral axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single, distinct, small orange-hued circular punctate mark or lesion is visible on the mid-lateral flank, positioned below the primary cluster of macro-annuli.
